name: Negligee: Spring Clean
source:
The girls of the Negligee Lingerie shop are in for their toughest day of the year, the mega sale spring clean event!

How will the girls handle things when what seems like the entire town descends on the store to get the best deals and get some new intimate attire.

[From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/511280/Negligee_Spring_Clean/]Steam[/URL]]
translation:
Negligee内衣店的女孩们，即将迎来一年中最艰难的一天——春季清仓大促销！

仿佛全镇的人都涌进店里，抢购最划算的新内衣。面对这般阵仗，女孩们将如何应对？

[摘自[URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/511280/Negligee_Spring_Clean/]Steam[/URL]]
